plugins.name: android-compose-review
plugins.description: Code-review orchestrator for Jetpack Compose Android apps (Clean Architecture + MVVM + Hilt), bundling 13 focused Compose/Kotlin review skills.

plugins.name: android-unit-testing
plugins.description: Generate and review unit tests for Clean Architecture + MVVM Android apps (Repository / UseCase / ViewModel) to ≥90% coverage; detects MockK vs Mockito, JUnit version, and error model.

plugins.name: android-codegen-non-ui
plugins.description: Generate the non-UI data layer (Retrofit API → Repository → UseCase, + Room/Paging/DI) from a Scramble/Laravel OpenAPI JSON. Two-stage Plan→Generate pipeline with a developer review gate. Assumes com.ictechnology.core.

plugins.name: android-codegen-ui
plugins.description: Generate Jetpack Compose UI (screens + ViewModel/UiState/Event/FieldState, components, icons, strings, permissions) from a Figma design. Six-stage pipeline with a developer review gate; generates features/presentation only. Requires the Figma MCP server.
